name: plugins-and-mods-by-xryul
description: Claude Code plugins and mods by xRyul: Dracula transcript styling, a Bash permission gate, a prompt timeline pane and a session outputs pane

plugins.name: dracula-theme-mod
plugins.description: Dracula transcript styling: tool call cards, coloured status lines, inline code pills and no dots

plugins.name: bash-permissions
plugins.description: Asks before dangerous Bash commands (git push, gt submit, pscale deploy, mysql, …), showing the whole command, a one-sentence explanation and a danger score. /bash-permissions shows the rules.

plugins.name: prompt-timeline
plugins.description: A pane of this session's prompts that opens on a tree of every branch a rewind or a fork left, each prompt with what its turn did, its context usage and when it was sent; click one to scroll the transcript to it or continue from its branch, switch to the list for their age, or find to search every prompt's full text. /timeline shows or hides it, and /resume-at opens a session at any of its messages.

plugins.name: session-outputs
plugins.description: An Outputs pane listing what this session produced: the claude.ai Artifacts Claude published with their kind and version, the files it changed with the lines each gained and lost, the documents it wrote, and the images you pasted or it created, newest first; click a row to open it, a change as a diff in VS Code, c copies its link or path, s shows it in its folder. /session-outputs shows the pane.
